chapters.title: THE STEM CELL DOME / CAMPAIGN
narration: Twenty-one thousand at the floor. Two hundred and seventy-seven square feet.

chapters.title: The shell is a boat hull

chapters.title: Everything else snaps onto the outside
narration: Fan, water heater, cooling, shower. None of them cut a new hole.

chapters.title: The ground is not ours and it is not yours
narration: The landowner builds the pad. It stays when the dome leaves.

chapters.title: Bring your own ground
narration: Twenty-one to twenty-eight thousand. Then it is yours.
